title: Porsche UK - The Turbo, February 1995, M64/60
notes: Corrected against the visually checked brochure, PDF pages 6, 7 and 22, on 2026-10-02: bore 100 mm, stroke 76.4 mm, published displacement 3600 cm3, compression ratio 8.0:1, 300 kW (408 hp printed; approximately 408 PS), 540 Nm, maximum boost 0.8 bar gauge. Previous 9.5:1, 1.0 bar / 350 kPa absolute, 232 kg dry engine mass and 12 L oil capacity attribution is withdrawn. This brochure does not establish those engine mass/oil-capacity figures. At assumed 1.0 bar ambient, 0.8 bar gauge is 1.8 bar absolute. The former anstack URL returned HTTP 404; this archive copy was reviewed. No manufacturing drawing or exact alloy/shaft-speed map supplied.
